title: Fix Admin Lockout, Restore Login Screen, Fix Save Buttons, Remove Coming Soon Placeholders

requirements.text: Reset admin authentication so that the AdminGuard component grants full admin access by default when no valid session exists, effectively bypassing the lockout. The hardcoded credentials in AdminLoginPage must be reset to a known default (e.g., username: 'admin', password: 'admin123') and the session creation logic must be verified to correctly write to localStorage/sessionStorage so that the AdminGuard recognizes it as valid.

quotes: Force Admin Role: Reset the database permissions so that the current session or IP is automatically granted Full Admin Access until I can set a new password.

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /admin no longer shows 'Unauthorized' or 'Actor not available' errors
A valid session written by AdminLoginPage is recognized by AdminGuard without redirect loop
Default credentials (admin / admin123) successfully log in and create a session

requirements.text: Rebuild the /admin login page (AdminLoginPage.tsx) to always display a Username and Password input form. The login page must be visible at /admin/login (or /login as currently routed in App.tsx). Ensure App.tsx routes /admin and all /admin/* paths through AdminGuard, which redirects unauthenticated users to the login page. The login page itself must NOT be wrapped in AdminGuard. Verify TanStack Router route definitions so the login route is always reachable.

quotes: Restore Login Screen: Re-build the /admin login page with a Username and Password field. Do not allow access to settings without this.

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /admin or any /admin/* route while unauthenticated redirects to the login page
The login page renders a Username field, Password field, and a Submit button
Submitting correct credentials grants access to the admin dashboard
Submitting incorrect credentials shows an error message and does not grant access
The login page is never wrapped in AdminGuard and is always accessible

requirements.text: Fix the backend actor availability issue causing 'Actor not available' errors. In useQueries.ts, all mutations that write settings (UPI ID, shop status, slogan) must wait for the actor to be available before executing, and must handle the case where the actor is null/undefined gracefully with a clear error message. In the Motoko backend (backend/main.mo), verify that the admin-only write functions (setUpiId, setShopStatus, setSlogan, or equivalent) do not perform a principal-based authorization check that would reject calls from the frontend session — if they do, either remove the check or make it compatible with the anonymous/session-based admin flow being used.

quotes: Fix Setting Save: Repair the 'Save' buttons for UPI and Shop Status so they stop showing 'Unauthorized'. They must successfully write to the database.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Save on the UPI ID field in AdminSettingsPage saves the value without showing 'Unauthorized'
Clicking Save on the Shop Status toggle in AdminPage/ShopStatusToggle saves without showing 'Unauthorized'
No 'Actor not available' error is thrown when mutations are invoked
Settings changes persist and are reflected after page reload

requirements.text: Remove all 'Coming Soon' placeholder content from SearchPage.tsx, WalletPage.tsx, and MyOrdersPage.tsx. Replace them with real, functional implementations: (1) SearchPage must render a search input that filters products from the backend by name/category and displays results using ProductCard components. (2) WalletPage must display the user's wallet/cashback balance and transaction history if the backend supports it, or a basic wallet UI with balance display. (3) MyOrdersPage must display the current user's past orders fetched from the backend. Update BottomNavBar.tsx links for Search and Wallet to navigate to these now-functional pages.

quotes: Cleanup: Remove all 'Coming Soon' and 'Coming Soon' placeholders from the Home page once and for all. Activate Search and Wallet for real.

acceptanceCriteria: SearchPage no longer shows a 'Coming Soon' message; it shows a working search input and results
Typing in SearchPage filters and displays matching products
WalletPage no longer shows a 'Coming Soon' message; it shows a wallet/cashback UI with real or zero-state data
MyOrdersPage no longer shows a 'Coming Soon' message; it shows order history or an empty-state if no orders exist
BottomNavBar Search and Wallet links navigate to the functional pages

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
The login page route must remain publicly accessible without AdminGuard wrapping
All admin write operations must remain protected behind the login session check — do not remove AdminGuard from admin routes
nonGoals: Implementing IP-based or server-side session management
Adding Internet Identity (ICP) authentication to the admin flow
Redesigning the overall visual theme or layout
Adding new product categories or backend data models
